p.s: I disagree about this question for the following two reasons.
First, comunicate with other people is basis for human beings.
Nowadays, most young people have mobile phone and using it by not calling but mailing.
In fact, mailing is useful and easy to send message.
But I think mail is difficult to express their feelings.
Second, I think human beings can not live alone.
Everyone wants friends to speak of, and anyone loves human beings.
A long time ago, there was no mobile phone, TV, and television game.
So young people played outside with many friends who live nearby them.
But now, boys and girls play inside because of television game.
It is bad for their health and heart.
I hope young people play outside.
Because they are treasure for future.
